name: Segment hippocampal and amygdala nuclei
summary: Segments hippocampal subfields and amygdala nuclei with FreeSurfer 7.3.2 segmentHA_T1.sh on a FreeSurfer subject directory and returns the updated directory.
description: Copies the FreeSurfer subject directory and runs segmentHA_T1.sh (segmentHA_T2.sh when a T2.mgz is found), adding the lh/rh hippoAmygLabels volumes to mri/. Use it before converting those labels into a parcellation. Requires a completed recon-all.

inputs.description: The path to the freesurfer datatype

outputs.description: Output freesurfer datatype including hippocampal and amygdala nuclei segmentation
